description: Coordinate Family Care, Together. Siblings coordinate schedules, medications, and expenses for aging parents.

userStories.title: Create Care Circle
userStories.description: As a family caregiver, I can create a Care Circle and invite my siblings so we can coordinate care together.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign up with email + password or Google OAuth

userStories.title: Parent Profile
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can set up my parent's profile with health info so everyone has context.

userStories.title: Care Schedule
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can create and claim care shifts so we know who's responsible when.

userStories.title: Medication Tracking
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can log medications and confirm they were given so nothing gets missed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add medication: name, dosage, frequency, time

userStories.title: Medical Timeline
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can log medical events (doctor visits, hospitalizations) so we have a shared history.
acceptanceCriteria: Add event: date, type, doctor, notes
Types: doctor visit, ER, hospital, test, other
All members can add and view

userStories.title: Expense Tracking & Splitting
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can log care expenses and split them fairly among siblings.
acceptanceCriteria: Add expense: amount, category, paid by, date
Categories: medical, supplies, food, transport, other

userStories.title: Emergency Alerts
userStories.description: As a caregiver, I can send an emergency alert to all circle members instantly.
